scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, owners change while the work continues: across the top, four hands in a row, each passing a relay baton to the next from left to right, each hand above one small flag. The four flag labels, left to right: PALAMON 2000, BAIN CAPITAL 2004, HG 2010, HELLMAN & FRIEDMAN 2016. Underneath all four, one long unbroken teal conveyor belt running left to right, carrying software boxes, a stack of customer folders, a laptop and a toolbox, labelled once PRODUCT WORK CONTINUES. Below the belt's right end, a toolbox with a blank clipboard (only wavy lines, no words) and a large question mark, labelled WHO FUNDS THE REST?

MIDDLE ZONE, growth depends on the months compared: two calendars side by side on one shelf. The left calendar has only ten of its twelve month squares filled in and two blank; above it a tall arrow pointing up, crossed out with a thin navy line, labelled 10 MONTHS: +37.7%. The right calendar has all twelve month squares filled; above it a short, clean, straight arrow pointing up with an ochre check mark beside it, labelled FULL YEAR: +8.9%.

RIGHT ZONE, adjusted earnings versus the loss: on a plain horizontal baseline with no axis numbers or tick labels, a tall teal bar standing above the line on the left, labelled ADJUSTED EBITDA €113.0M, and on the right a short navy-outlined bar hanging below the line, labelled LOSS −€56.8M. Between them, two large ochre blocks sit as downward steps: the first labelled AMORTIZATION €72.5M, the second labelled FINANCE CHARGE €72.0M. Next to the finance block, a small blank receipt (only wavy lines, no words) with a coin stack, labelled PAID €52.1M, joined to the block by a short dotted line.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: PALAMON 2000, BAIN CAPITAL 2004, HG 2010, HELLMAN & FRIEDMAN 2016, PRODUCT WORK CONTINUES, WHO FUNDS THE REST?, 10 MONTHS: +37.7%, FULL YEAR: +8.9%, ADJUSTED EBITDA €113.0M, AMORTIZATION €72.5M, FINANCE CHARGE €72.0M, PAID €52.1M, LOSS −€56.8M. No month names, digits, axis numbers or words on the calendars, boxes, folders, clipboard, receipt, baseline or screens; do not write RECEIPT, TASK LIST or 0. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Four owners, Palamon in 2000, Bain Capital in 2004, Hg in 2010 and Hellman & Friedman in 2016, pass a baton while product work continues on one conveyor belt, with the question of who funds the rest; a ten-month 2016 calendar gives a crossed-out 37.7% growth figure beside a full-year calendar giving 8.9%; adjusted EBITDA of €113.0 million steps down through €72.5 million of amortization and a €72.0 million finance charge, of which €52.1 million was paid, to a €56.8 million loss.
caption: Owners pass the company on while its product work continues; compare the same months, and read the adjusted profit beside the loss and the cash actually paid.
